tailoring.headline: Developer SAP Commerce | Java & Spring | SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris), Java, and Spring. Strong background in RESTful APIs, microservices, database performance tuning, and CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with hands-on experience in production support, troubleshooting, and agile delivery across international teams.
keywords_missing: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik (Bachelor in Computer Engineering / IT)

cover_en.subject: Application: Developer SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Developer SAP Commerce (m/w/d) role at CANCOM SE. With over 5 years of professional experience building and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise in Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Feature Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: CI/CD & DevOps Support
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows.

bullets.label: Quality Assurance & Testing
bullets.text: Built automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit to maintain code quality and coverage.

bullets.label: Incident Management & Operations
bullets.text: Investigated and resolved integration bottlenecks and supported production troubleshooting, maintenance, and monitoring.

cover_en.gap: While my testing background focuses primarily on automated unit and integration test suites with JUnit rather than UI-tests, I am very keen to expand my testing skill set to cover UI-tests as well.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, allowing me to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with CANCOM SE.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at CANCOM SE because of your innovative, agile, and sustainable environment where modern IT solutions improve collaboration across life domains. Contributing to your digital journey as part of an open-minded international team aligns perfectly with my professional experience in SAP Commerce and my passion for delivering robust enterprise e-commerce platforms.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring expertise to help CANCOM SE drive innovative digital commerce solutions and reliable platform operations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw the Developer SAP Commerce role at CANCOM and am very interested. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce (Hybris), Java, and Spring experience across Rockwell and Shell, plus valid work authorization in Germany, I'd love to connect. Earliest start: 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Developer SAP Commerce (m/w/d) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the Developer SAP Commerce (m/w/d) position at CANCOM SE. With over 5 years of experience in Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring hands-on expertise in backend development, CI/CD workflows, incident management, and automated testing with JUnit.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting December 16, 2026. I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
